reports.text: Full story on the Astros' ongoing managerial search, which will involve longtime Houston nemesis Albert Pujols - www.nytimes.com/athletic/775...
Albert Pujols is interviewing for the Astros' managerial vacancy this week, source tells @theathletic.com - www.nytimes.com/athletic/775...
Astros owner Jim Crane said he did interview some managerial candidates during the GM search process, but now that Randy Flores is hired, Crane said Flores will take over that search.
Astros’ GM search raises questions — and gives Randy Flores little time to establish new era - www.nytimes.com/athletic/774...

Full story on the Astros' hiring Randy Flores after a 68-day GM search that initially focused on someone else and, now, leaves Flores with a lot to do in very little time. Free and unlocked - www.nytimes.com/athletic/774...
The Houston Astros have hired Randy Flores as their new GM, they announced.
The Astros have hired Randy Flores as their general manager, they just announced

Oz Ocampo interviewed with Astros owner Jim Crane on Monday for an assistant general manager role, source tells @theathletic.com. Ocampo, who now works for the Colorado Rockies, worked for the Astros from 2012-20 and in 2022. Most of Ocampo’s work came in international scouting and acquisitions
The Astros exercised Isaac Paredes’ $13.35 million club option.

The Astros added reliever Roddery Muñoz and catcher César Salazar to the 40-man roster, made their trade for pitcher Evan Reifert official and outrighted Jake Meyers off the 40-man roster. Meyers will elect free agency. Houston’s 40-man roster is at 39 players.
Tatsuya Imai will exercise his $18 million player option and return to the Astros in 2027, source tells @theathletic.com. First: @jonheyman.bsky.social - www.nytimes.com/athletic/773...
The Astros announced they released Nelson Velázquez so he could pursue an opportunity with a club in Asia.
